data.one_liner: Fixes picture orientation for photos taken in landscape mode on specific devices.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that corrects image orientation based on EXIF data, specifically designed to fix issues where certain devices save pictures in landscape orientation when they were taken in portrait.
use_when: You need to fix incorrect image orientation caused by device EXIF data on Android or iOS
You are processing images taken with the camera or selected from the gallery
avoid_when: You only need generic image manipulation or filters without EXIF rotation fixes
You are building a web-only application (not documented as supported for web)
strengths: Solves specific device-dependent EXIF orientation bugs
Provides options to either rotate and save or return the rotated file directly
weaknesses: Limited scope restricted to EXIF orientation fixing
Requires platform-specific configuration/permissions on Android depending on storage usage
data.setup_notes: May require AndroidManifest.xml permissions depending on whether you manipulate files from internal storage or external locations.

alternatives.name: image
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides comprehensive image processing capabilities including EXIF and rotation in pure Dart.

alternatives.name: flutter_image_compress
alternatives.why_pick_it: Allows image compression and EXIF handling in a single package.
